_comment: Cue list for Squatch Life. Two kinds live here. A cue with `prompt` is a sound effect and goes to ElevenLabs sound-generation. A cue with `say` is a line of dialogue and goes to text-to-speech using the voice named in `voice`, resolved against the `voices` block below. Run `npm run sfx` for everything, `npm run sfx:vo` for just the spoken lines. Any cue without a file falls back to the built-in WebAudio synth, so the game is playable either way.

voices._comment: Every spoken line resolves its voice here, so the character sounds like one person. Paste an ElevenLabs voice id into `id` -- `npm run sfx:voices` lists what is on your account. Nothing spoken will generate until this is set.

player._note: The man who lives here. Mid thirties, flat delivery, talks to himself because there is nobody else in. Not doing a bit -- he is just narrating his own afternoon to an empty room.

announcer._note: 97.8 THE SQUATCH station voice. Adverts, links and the automated overnight. Shouts everything. Low stability and high style on purpose -- this is the one voice allowed to be completely unhinged.

lou1._note: Lou, of Lou & Lou. Breakfast show. Chattier of the two.

lou2._note: The other Lou. Two Lous is the whole premise, so they have to be tellable apart or the joke does not land.

booski._note: Booski. CS gambling show. Has put his rent on a Silver lobby and wants to talk about it.

ape._note: Ape. The straight man to Booski. Delivers legal disclaimers flatly.

irish._note: Irish's Deep Dives. Conspiratorial, confiding, building to nothing. British storyteller voice makes the egg material land harder.

eric._note: Eric, of What's Happening in India. Tries to run a real news segment.

gratin._note: Gratin. Wants to get to the butter chicken. Older, crisper, entirely uninterested in the tech story.

hogmama._note: Hog Mama's Late Night Improv. No script, no plan, and increasingly aware of it.

uncle._note: 98.8 UNCLE SQUATCH BEATS. Smooth, low, unhurried -- the opposite of everything on 97.8.

ksqch._note: 101.7 KSQCH. Scrappy, rough, sounds like it is broadcast out of a garage, because it is.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.03hazs6
sfx.say: Same room as always. Doors at half six. Do not turn up at half seven.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0ceeyjp
sfx.say: Somebody always turns up at half seven.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1my5813
sfx.say: Come showered. Come dressed. Come having eaten something.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.09zbqt7
sfx.say: That is not us being rude, that is a direct request from the room.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0fwkjqq
sfx.say: If you are new: it is not that kind of meeting. Bring nothing. Turn up.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.09ub91c
sfx.say: Wednesday. Seven. 97.8 The Squatch, reminding you where to be.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0gen8dz
sfx.say: 97.8 The Squatch. Nobody is in the building.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0twfsvf
sfx.say: The following is a repeat. Everything is a repeat.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0m4q0kv
sfx.say: If it’s on the air… it probably shouldn’t be.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0mggvzp
sfx.say: We’ll be back at six. Probably.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1fd40j6
sfx.say: Eat those pasture raised eggs folks.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0y68wik
sfx.say: This is an automated broadcast. There is nobody to complain to.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0u9v7ne
sfx.say: The overnight tape has been running for eleven years.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0bwdtn9
sfx.say: A reminder that nothing on this station has ever been checked.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1vtvpq8
sfx.say: If you are awake, that is between you and the ceiling.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1u2ak1b
sfx.say: Hog Mama has left the building. She left the microphone on.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.17jjafg
sfx.say: …That was the tape. The tape does that.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0onxfz6
sfx.say: 97.8. Broadcasting to an empty city at an unreasonable hour.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1vxa4x4
sfx.say: Lou & Lou at six. Both Lous. Allegedly.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1rj3emp
sfx.say: Whatever you were going to do tonight, you have done it now.

sfx.name: vo.toilet.hint.1
sfx.say: Nothing doing yet. Couple of cigarettes usually gets that moving.

sfx.name: vo.toilet.hint.2
sfx.say: Not yet. Give it a few smokes and we will be back in here.

sfx.name: vo.toilet.hint.3
sfx.say: Empty. It always turns up about four cigarettes in.

sfx.name: vo.photo.1
sfx.say: Ahh. What a good time.

sfx.name: vo.photo.2
sfx.say: Let me hear you. Let me sing.

sfx.name: vo.photo.3
sfx.say: It is all love.

sfx.name: vo.photo.4
sfx.say: Let it be known: that was a great time.

sfx.name: vo.photo.5
sfx.say: Piping hot.

sfx.name: vo.photo.6
sfx.say: Oh, that is a good one.

sfx.name: vo.photo.7
sfx.say: We were so young. That was eighteen months ago.

sfx.name: vo.photo.8
sfx.say: Everyone in that picture owes me money.

sfx.name: vo.photo.9
sfx.say: I remember about half of that.

sfx.name: vo.photo.10
sfx.say: That was the night, that was.

sfx.name: vo.photo.11
sfx.say: Look at the state of us.

sfx.name: vo.photo.12
sfx.say: Good lads. All of them. Mostly.

sfx.name: vo.photo.13
sfx.say: That is going to stay up there forever now.

sfx.name: vo.photo.14
sfx.say: I have walked past that a thousand times.

sfx.name: vo.photo.15
sfx.say: Been meaning to straighten that.

sfx.name: vo.photo.16
sfx.say: One of the good ones, that.

sfx.name: vo.photo.17
sfx.say: Should get everyone together again.

sfx.name: vo.photo.18
sfx.say: Nobody has aged well. Including me.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.17jd61p
sfx.say: …and that is why you never trust a man who owns two planes.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.096re3b
sfx.say: I know. That is what I am telling you.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0op3f7n
sfx.say: Caller, you are on The Squatch. Go ahead. …Caller? They have gone.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0w7k19f
sfx.say: Somebody in the chat says we are "just two guys called Lou". Correct.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.0pw7mlf
sfx.say: The airport says we are not allowed back. We will fight it on air.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0tvxvit
sfx.say: Weather: it is doing something out there. Look out of a window.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.1vvestx
sfx.say: Morning. If you are only just getting up, that is fine. Nobody is counting.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.1gkjfpf
sfx.say: Friendslop segment. Who is upset today. Start at the top.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0metb4f
sfx.say: A man has written in to say we have never once helped him. Noted, and kept.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0rl52pp
sfx.say: The chat wants the fart segment. The chat always wants the fart segment.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.1f75e6t
sfx.say: We are not doing the fart segment before eight. We have standards until eight.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.0mtoijf
sfx.say: Somebody has a meeting tomorrow night and has told everyone about it twice.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0navfzp
sfx.say: That is not a bit. Somebody genuinely rang in about that.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0d4c90q
sfx.say: If you are eating breakfast right now, you are ahead of most of our audience.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.1a057jc
sfx.say: If you are not eating breakfast right now, we are not going to make a thing of it.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.1ixqrjg
sfx.say: I own two planes.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.1kv3xuq
sfx.say: The other Lou is not here yet. I am both Lous this morning.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.06a6vky
sfx.say: He has walked in. He has heard that. He is making a face.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.141qlvm
sfx.say: I have landed there.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.0cqixr2
sfx.say: There is a news wire in this building. I have seen it. I have never read it.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou1.0ftvj3g
sfx.say: It is eight.

sfx.name: radio.vo.lou2.06egb18
sfx.say: We are going to a break, which for us means one of us stops talking.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1v05271
sfx.say: That was one of ours. All of them are ours.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0rf28a0
sfx.say: Every record on this station was made by somebody in this group.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0cdawco
sfx.say: That is not a boast. It is closer to a disclosure.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1keapkw
sfx.say: Requests are open. Requests have always been open. Nobody has ever rung.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.11ryahr
sfx.say: This one charted. Internally. Among us.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.035km9h
sfx.say: If you know the words, you were probably there when it was written.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0qdc8ax
sfx.say: Somebody mixed this in a basement on monitors that cost forty dollars.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.10fsahj
sfx.say: That was written in one night. You can tell. We are not hiding it.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0ttl6xr
sfx.say: No royalties have ever been paid. No royalties have ever been owed.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.18s5tw7
sfx.say: This one was recorded the night before somebody had somewhere to be.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0rc2fyr
sfx.say: Turn it up. Nobody in this building is going to stop you.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.02o73bt
sfx.say: 97.8 The Squatch. The roster, on the roster.
